newsitem.title: USA: Pro Farmer pegs U.S. corn production at 8.2 bln bu.
newsitem.headline: Pro Farmer pegs U.S. corn production at 8.2 bln bu.

text.p: The Professional Farmers of America on Monday estimated U.S. corn production at 8.2 billion bushels and soybean production at 2.1 billion bushels, said Chip Flory, senior market analyst at Pro Farmer.

The group, which led a four-day tour last week through corn and soybean fields in Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Iowa and Minnesota, calculated the production estimates based on data collected during the tour, Flory said.
Pro Farmer estimated overall potential U.S. corn yield at 112 bushels per acre and soybean yield at 33 to 34 bushels per acre, Flory said.
The U.S. Agriculture Department in its August 12 report estimated U.S. corn production at 8.69 billion bushels and soybean output at 2.30 billion bushels.
USDA pegged overall U.S. corn yield at 118.7 bushels per acre and soybean yield at 36.2 bushels per acre.
